# show system global
FGT60C3G13029672 # config system global

end

FGT60C3G13029672 #


# show system interface
FGT60C3G13029672 # config system interface
    edit "dmz"
        set vdom "root"
        set ip 10.10.10.1 255.255.255.0
        set allowaccess ping https ssh http fgfm capwap
        set type physical
        set snmp-index 1
    next
    edit "wan2"
        set vdom "root"
        set mode dhcp
        set allowaccess ping fgfm auto-ipsec
        set type physical
        set snmp-index 2
    next
    edit "wan1"
        set vdom "root"
        set mode dhcp
        set allowaccess ping https ssh snmp http fgfm auto-ipsec
        set type physical
        set snmp-index 3
    next
    edit "modem"
        set vdom "root"
--More--

        set mode pppoe
        set type physical
        set snmp-index 4
    next
    edit "ssl.root"
        set vdom "root"
        set type tunnel
        set alias "SSL VPN interface"
        set snmp-index 7
    next
    edit "internal"
        set vdom "root"
        set ip 192.168.1.99 255.255.255.0
        set allowaccess ping https ssh http fgfm capwap
        set type physical
        set snmp-index 8
    next
end
